metadata.description: In this episode we will take you to a small village in Shilai Tehsil of Sirmaur district. People of hatti community live in this village. Hati tribal community wants to get schedule tribal status. They say that their lifestyle and culture meet all the criteria that are necessary for tribal status. We saw in this village that a water mill is used here. Apart from this, many such aspects of life were seen in this village which corroborate their claim.
